Hi Filipe,
I think your problem is that you are wrapping the definition of the application in an if clause which is not being evaluated as true when you run it on a server.  I have tried out your application by taking away the if statement and everything works as expected.  Link below:

https://tareef.shinyapps.io/simpleapp/
